title: Implement single section regeneration (regenerate-section.ts)
description: Implement src/lib/ai/regenerate-section.ts which regenerates the copy for a single section without re-running the full pipeline. Uses the existing condensed profile and prospect data.
acceptanceCriteria: Loads existing prospect data from DB (condensed profile, current sections)
Generates new content only for the specified section
Replaces the section's content in the site_config and saves to DB

steps.details: Load the prospect by ID. Get the condensed_profile and site_config. Find the section by sectionId in site_config.sections.

steps.description: Generate new content for the section
steps.details: Build a section-specific prompt: `Generate new content for the ${section.type} section of ${businessName}'s website. Be specific to ${industry} in ${location}. Profile: ${condensedProfile.summary}`. Call `generateObject` with the section-specific content schema. Return the new content.

steps.description: Update the section in site_config and save
steps.details: Replace the section's content in the config: `updatedConfig.sections = config.sections.map(s => s.id === sectionId ? { ...s, content: newContent } : s)`. Save updated site_config to DB via repository.

technicalNotes: This is called from both the API route (TASK-71) and can be triggered from the edit UI.
Cost: ~$0.002-0.005 per regeneration (single section, small output).
